purpose: One graph-on allocation-history diagnostic to capture the original CUDA Graph Trees pool-guard failure frames.

scope.instrumentation: torch._inductor.config.triton.cudagraph_trees_history_recording=True set by attempt-local history_entry.py before importing the unchanged source entrypoint

workload.model: 3B MoE, one dense block and 17 MoE blocks
workload.parallelism: EP8/FSDP2 on one eight-H100 NVLink server

diagnostic.question: Which live allocation was absent from tracked outputs at the first dense block 0 FORWARD warmup guard?
diagnostic.expected_evidence: The unchanged guard error's bad address and built-in allocator-history allocation frames, retained from every rank.
diagnostic.ownership_proof: All eight rank histories tie bad address 597168226304 to cuda_gemm::(anonymous namespace)::get_cached_workspace and cuda_gemm::gemm; loaded extension __file__ and binary hash remain unobserved.
diagnostic.snapshot_or_block_size: The built-in failure path is not expected to save a standalone snapshot or print block size.
diagnostic.loaded_gemm_module_provenance: Record only if an unchanged existing observation/log route exposes it; do not add a harness.
diagnostic.changed_failure_policy: A changed failure or unavailable frames is inconclusive; no retry, fallback, or broader audit.

launch_policy.launcher: torch.distributed.run, eight local ranks, source003 options and output routing
launch_policy.history_setting: Only the installed built-in Trees history setting above is added.

result.first_error_region: dense decoder block 0 compiled FORWARD warmup
result.first_error_message: Detected 1 tensor(s) in the cudagraph pool not tracked as outputs. All live allocations must be tracked for correctness.
preparation_failures: Early A004 wrapper guards would have rejected controller-created supervisor.log and launch.json; caught before launch and replaced by exact A003 script with only attempt path and script target changes.
One source-guard command doubled a repository-relative path and failed before hashing; corrected source guard passed all 22 files, archive, and preset.
Two patch-generation commands failed before file changes due to quoting/syntax; one postrun extraction command failed on escaped-newline matching, then direct JSON extraction succeeded.
Supervisor-only reading initially showed an unsymbolized stack tail; full per-rank error JSON revealed the address-linked CudaCherry producer frames.
